title: MZ Having Issues Trying to Make Persona Fusion Work

posts.author: Etrogade_
posts.body:
So long story short, I couldn't find a plugin that works the same way with persona fusion, so I've been trying to use
OZZ_SMT Demon Fusion
plugin as a work around. The way I would set it up is as follows:
The game checks what weapons I have (each weapon correlates to a class) and removes the weapon while adding a demon in its place.
The menu for fusion opens up allowing me to use the demon as a placeholder for the weapon
Once leaving the menu, the game checks whether or not the demon is there (in case if it was fused) and removes the demon in place of the weapon.
So far, I've been able to get Steps 1, 2, and 3 down with the partial exception of fusion. When the demon is fused in the menu, and I leave the menu, it's supposed to see that the demon is no longer there, and thus not return the weapon due to it being used in fusion. However, despite this, the weapon still remains. Here are screenshots of the code with comment left to explain what happens and what
should
happen.
Now there is another problem I do see with this in the future. In my game, there's supposed to be 70 classes/weapons for the protagonist to use. So I'm not sure how much of an issue it would be for rpg maker to have to process all of that without being slow. Regardless, could someone tell me what I'm doing wrong here?
